description: Values of several A1 ranges in one read, as Sheets renders them (FORMATTED_VALUE), as numbers (UNFORMATTED_VALUE: a double, so read_rows is the tool for money) or as formulas (FORMULA), chosen by A1 ranges or by data_filters. A large answer is cut at a row (`totalRows` says how many there were).

account.description: Which account: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Empty means the default account.

data_filters.description: Instead of A1 ranges: Sheets DataFilters, each one of {"a1Range": "Sheet1!A1:B2"}, {"gridRange": {...}} or {"developerMetadataLookup": {"metadataKey": "...", ...}}: cells found by the developer metadata tagged on them.

date_time_render.description: For dates when value_render is not FORMATTED_VALUE.

ranges.description: A1 ranges, each naming its sheet: "Sheet1!A1:D20", "Sheet1!B:B", "'Q3 plan'!2:2", or a sheet name alone.

spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet's id, or its URL.

name: get_values
title: Read cell values
